name: Woman Hunter ~Goukan Kyokashou o Motsu Otoko~
source:
* The world
No "Country" existed since 100 years ago.
The society has turned into chaos. In such time, people gathered around and borough was established.
Each borough had different form. Among those, there were some people called "Hunter" who try to resolve criminals.
This story features such hunter's partial life.

*Female Criminal
The town was consisted of only female.
In such town, crimes were done by female criminals.
In order to punish them, severe humiliation is given.
This work illustrates graphics about women being violated and fallen.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048813.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
* 世界100年前起，世界上不再存在“国家”。社会陷入混乱，人们聚集并建立行政区。每个行政区形态不同，其中有些人被称为“猎人”，负责解决罪犯。本故事讲述一名猎人的部分人生。

* 女性罪犯
城镇只有女性。犯罪由女性罪犯实施，为惩罚她们，会给予严厉羞辱。本作描绘女性遭侵犯、堕落的画面。

[译自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE048813.html]DLsite English[/url]]
